subject: Sarah's 3AM scan that saved her wedding
preview_text: She screenshotted a birthday text. What the AI found made her cancel the engagement.
body_paragraphs: Sarah was planning her wedding. Two months out, she screenshotted a text from her fiancé's birthday message. She didn't know why — just a gut feeling. Our team saw her scan come through at 3AM and we stopped everything.

The AI flagged a pattern of subtle gaslighting across their last 14 conversations. Things she'd brushed off as 'jokes' or 'stress' were actually consistent manipulation. She told us later, 'I thought I was overthinking. The app showed me I was finally seeing clearly.'

She used the Pattern Detection feature across their chat history. It connected dots she couldn't see in the moment — love bombing after fights, guilt trips disguised as concern. The Toxicity Score didn't just give her data. It gave her permission to leave.

Open Red Flag Scanner AI now. Go to your chat history and run a Pattern Detection scan on your most recent conversation. See what Sarah saw. P.S. She's now dating someone who sends her normal texts at normal hours. She says the scan was her first honest conversation.
